title: Preparing 1/2 SŠ Algal Inorganic Nutrient Medium
author: Jakub Nedbal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdzai72e
materials: Prepare all the reagents and labware.
Adjust the pH to 7.5 using KOH.

steps.title: Sterilize deionized water
steps.instruction: Autoclave 500 ml of deionized water in a clean glass bottle and allow it to cool down.

steps.title: Add nutrient components
steps.instruction: Working in a sterile laminar flow hood, add the components listed in the table (STEP 1) into the autoclaved deionized water in the order listed. Do not add KOH at this stage.

steps.title: Adjust medium pH
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the medium to approximately 7.5 using 2 M KOH.

substeps.instruction: Transfer a small aliquot (1.5 ml) of the medium into a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Measure the pH of the medium in the Falcon tube using a pH meter.
Add a small aliquot (5 μl) of 2 M KOH to the medium.
Mix well by closing the bottle and shaking or turning it upside down several times.
Repeat the measurement and addition of KOH until the pH reaches approximately 7.5.

steps.title: Label and store medium
steps.instruction: Label the bottle with '1/2 SŠ', initials, date, and pH, then store the medium under specific conditions.

substeps.instruction: Warm to room temperature before each use.
Only open the bottle inside a sterile cabinet.
